newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Kinkel says EU past point of return on EMU.
newsitem.headline: Kinkel says EU past point of return on EMU.

text.p: German Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel said on Sunday that the European Union was beyond turning back on its march to a single currency.
"I think we have reached the point of no return on the way to the euro," Kinkel told reporters at an informal European Union foriegn ministers meeting.
Kinkel said failure of economic and monetary union (EMU) would hurt Europe.
"Not getting there (to a single currency) would be a blow to Europe," he said.
"If we don't succeed it will be for us -- and from the view of those outside -- a serious setback for Europe," Kinkel said.
He added that he believed financial markets were now prepared for the single currency.
